 At Jabalpur

sentences.text:
On The 31st Of March, 2026
 Misc. Petition No. 1881 of 2026
 Smt. Neelam Singh
 Versus
 General Mager/ Nodel Officer And Others

Appearance:
 Shri Vinay Singh Baghel - Advocate for the petitioner  Shri Naveen Ahuja Government Advocate for the respond  ORDER

The present petition has been filed for direction to the tribunal under Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957 for timely adjudication of the case pending before the Tribunal in the matter of assessment of appropriate and suitable compensation for the land acquired from the petitioner.

entities.text: Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. It is contended by counsel for the petitioner that the proceedings are pending before the Tribunal since 2021 and the matter is being continuously fixed for final argument since 24/04/2025, but since last almost 1 year, the final argument have not been heard by the said tribunal and therefore,
the disposal of the matter is getting delayed.
3.
Considering the aforesaid and considering the position that since 24/04/2025, the matter is being fixed for final arguments
, therefore, the Tribunal is directed to decide the matter on its own merits within a period of 2 MP-1881-2026 2 months from the date of production of copy of this order.
4. With the aforesaid direction, the petition is disposed of.
